column3: Full-body front view of H standing, trying to lift a small cup of tea with both hands, arms trembling and sore, wincing in pain, tiny shake lines around the arms, funny exaggerated face.
Upper-body front view of H holding his right wrist with his left hand, wincing in pain, a small red glow around the wrist.

Upper-body front view of H standing calm with a translucent glowing blue brain visible inside his head and thin glowing yellow nerve lines running from the brain down his neck into his chest and arms, like an anatomy diagram, confident face.
Full-body side view of H standing in front of a tall plain standing mirror, flexing his chest and arms proudly, his reflection visible in the mirror, pleased face.
Upper-body front view of H holding up one single small round biscuit between two fingers, staring at it, disappointed unimpressed face.
Full-body front view of H standing next to a big round wall clock on a stand, pointing at the clock with one hand, explaining face.
Front view, camera low at floor level, of H in the bottom of a push-up with his elbows flared straight out to the sides like a letter T, strained face, a small red glow on both shoulders.
Front view, camera low at floor level, of H in the bottom of a push-up with his elbows tucked in at about 45 degrees close to his body, calm controlled face, a small green glow on both shoulders.
Full-body pure side view of H in the top of a push-up on his FISTS (knuckles on the floor, wrists straight), arms straight, body perfectly straight from head to heels, exactly two legs, focused face.
Full-body pure side view of H in the top of a knee push-up: knees on the floor, feet raised behind, arms straight, hands under shoulders, body straight from head to knees, calm face.

Full-body pure side view of H doing a wall push-up: standing a step away from a plain vertical wall, leaning in, hands flat on the wall at shoulder height, arms straight, body straight, calm face. The wall drawn as a simple vertical surface.
Full-body pure side view of H in the top of a decline push-up: feet raised on a simple wooden chair, hands on the floor, arms straight, body straight, focused face.
Full-body pure side view of H in the top of a push-up, arms straight, body straight, looking completely bored, yawning with his mouth wide open, exactly two legs.
